items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: it wouldn't be no Count Basie stuff.

ctx.x: And everybody didn't think I was going to do it but I did it. Man I came home and thought about it and knew what kind of sound that I wanted. Different, it wouldn't be no Count Basie stuff. It would be a different kind of band - jazz. I figured that 12 people voiced right, we could play jazz music man with that many pieces and work. I got the musicians together to start rehearsing and I didn't have no

problem getting musicians because when the news got around that I was getting ready to do this thing, then the musicians said hey man, I'm available, you know. So I didn't have to really look for any musicians. Guys was here. So, we started rehearsing. And I didn't know anything, like the band jumped up off the ground and all of a sudden you know here I (Village) am in the Vanguard playing in Thad Jones' place, you know. And the band was a hit and everybody liked it, you know. And before I know it, now I'm…
